summary: Every factual claim in the report matches the checks, snapshot, rendered HTML and screenshots, and it discloses the one real snag; the only thing it leaves out is a minor cosmetic issue with paragraph spacing.

claims.claim: 3 block element types (richTextBlock, imageBlock, quoteBlock) in the Blocks folder
claims.evidence: snapshot.json lists all three element types; check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders passes; grade.md confirms they are in the Blocks folder

claims.claim: Blog Block Grid data type, 12 columns, all three blocks allowed at root and in areas
claims.evidence: snapshot.json Blog Block Grid has gridColumns 12 and three blocks, each with allowAtRoot and allowInAreas set to true

claims.claim: 2 templates and 2 page types in the Pages folder; siteRoot allows blogFrontPage, blogFrontPage allows blogPost
claims.evidence: check.json counts show templates: 2 and schema.docTypesInFolders passes; grade.md confirms the allowed children

claims.claim: Media folder 'Blog' with 5 Unsplash photos imported
claims.evidence: check.json content.hasMedia (5 items), content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos (5 of 5) and content.mediaInFolders all pass; uSync Media/blog.config exists

claims.claim: Front page has title, intro, one rich text block and a list of posts
claims.evidence: frontpage screenshot and pages/index.html show the title, intro, a welcome paragraph and two post cards

claims.claim: Two posts, each with 4 blocks in order: rich text, image with caption/credit, rich text, quote
claims.evidence: pages/why_mcp_is_awesome.html shows richTextBlock, imageBlock, richTextBlock, quoteBlock; the caption includes the photographer credit; grade.md confirms both posts

claims.claim: All three pages published; domain / (en-US) set on the front page
claims.evidence: check.json content.allPublished and content.domainAssigned ('MCP Blog: /') pass; uSync Domains/1101_en-us.config exists

claims.claim: ModelsBuilder models generated; builds have 0 errors
claims.evidence: check.json build.ok shows 0 errors and 10 warnings; the changes list includes BlogFrontPage, BlogPost and the three block .generated.cs files

claims.claim: Plain view models, one ViewComponent per block, adapters with mapping only and no markup
claims.evidence: check.json code.viewComponentPerBlock, code.adapterPerBlock, code.adaptersHaveNoMarkup and code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents all pass

claims.claim: Templates use GetBlockGridHtmlAsync; front page lists posts with link, date, excerpt and cropped image; Tailwind throughout
claims.evidence: check.json code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper passes; the HTML uses Tailwind classes; the screenshots show styled cards with cropped images, dates and excerpts

claims.claim: Frontend built: dist/site.css (12 kB) and dist/main.js
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt passes and site.stylesheetsLoad returns 200; main.js is in the changes list; the exact 12 kB size was not checked

claims.claim: All three URLs return 200; zero 'Could not render component'
claims.evidence: check.json crawl shows status 200 and empty renderErrors for all 3 pages

claims.claim: Rich text rendered as HTML (not escaped), blockquote and image credit render; cropped image URL and CSS return 200
claims.evidence:
pages/why_mcp_is_awesome.html has real

tags, a blockquote and a caption with the credit; crawl assets show the images and CSS returning 200

claims.claim: Initial snag with siteRoot allowed children, fixed
claims.evidence: grade.md notes it skipped the siteRoot update, fixed it after create-page failed, and disclosed it in the report

claims.claim: ImageSharp vulnerability warnings come from the scaffold
claims.evidence: grade.md: the build is clean apart from the scaffold's ImageSharp package warnings

all 43 automated checks pass; the only problem not mentioned is a cosmetic one the grader found (no spacing between paragraphs in rich text blocks, visible in the blogpost screenshot), which is not breakage
